package billing

import "context"

// Money carries minor units with their currency.
type Money struct {
	Minor    int64
	Currency string
}

// Quote is a price quote.
type Quote struct {
	UnitPriceMinor int64
	Rate           int64
	RateBp         int64
	Currency       string
}

// Record appends a charge through the generated wrapper: allowed here only.
func (s *Service) Record(ctx context.Context, m Money) error {
	return s.q.InsertCharge(ctx, m.Minor, m.Currency)
}

// A ratio in basis points stays an integer.
func shareBp(a, b int64) int64 { return a * 10_000 / b }
